name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task's only requirement is conditional—'if you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first'—so Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard is exactly right. at_exit is an 'if' condition, not a commanded goal, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

texts: If at_exit happens, then switch_toggled must have happened first.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
